scope: Historical validation-derived development pool of 100 reviews, repeatedly replayed; request counts are not independent labelled samples.
window_scope: Latency/error/queue windows are scheduled-arrival cohorts; completion throughput counts actual completions in each wall window. Device values are interval samples, not continuous process peaks.

additional_registration.selection: After observing the original 70%-capacity one-hour soak: 2827/2827 successful, HTTP P95 2136.98 ms. Earlier 50% short runs motivated this separate validation.
additional_registration.objective: Measure whether 50% of the frozen primary hybrid C1 capacity sustains the illustrative 95% of all attempts within 2 seconds over a full hour.
additional_registration.candidate_target: At least 95% of all scheduled attempts succeed within 2 seconds from scheduled arrival. This is an illustrative engineering target, not a contractual business SLA.
additional_registration.selection_rule: One new one-hour run at 50%; no model/prompt/threshold or runtime tuning; retain and report both 70% and 50% outcomes regardless of target attainment.
additional_registration.dataset: Replay the same 100 historical validation-derived development reviews; seed 20261109. No label access or evaluation-based model selection during execution.

burst_recovery.rule: Three consecutive scheduled recovery requests must all return successfully with client latency <= 1.10 x baseline P95 and queue wait <= max(100 ms, 1.10 x baseline queue P95). Failures reset the sequence. Baseline requires at least 10 successful requests; otherwise no confirmation.
burst_recovery.interpretation: This is an operational observation rule, not a business SLA, confidence interval, or proof of permanent recovery. Resolution depends on arrival spacing. A first in-band request alone does not establish recovery; later deterioration remains visible in phase/window metrics.
